packet.base_selection: first ALLOW in frozen independent evaluator output
packet.generation_method: deterministic mutations over first independently passing case

bootstrap.lower_bound: alpha-quantile of the replicate means, linear interpolation (numpy.quantile default)
bootstrap.resampling: per replicate draw n row indices uniformly with replacement (n = dataset size) and take the mean of the selected rows
bootstrap.rng: NumPy default_rng (PCG64), one fresh stream per dataset seeded as given

policy_evidence.signed_bytes: canonical JSON of the object with its 'signature' member removed; see LABELLING-SPEC.md section 3
